title: A single-phase V0.5Nb0.5ZrTi refractory high-entropy alloy with outstanding tensile properties
process_description: prepared by arc melting using pure metals of V, Nb, Zr, and Ti (>99.95 wt%) with re-melting at least 5 times inside a water-cooled copper cavity, followed by homogenization at 1150°C for 24 h in an argon-filled quartz tube.
